Files: msvcp140.dll, vcruntime140.dll, vcruntime140_1.dll.
The builder obtains these files from the installed Visual Studio 2022
VC/Redist/MSVC/<version>/x64/Microsoft.VC143.CRT directory and preserves
their bytes. Actual hashes and source directory are recorded in
native-dll-provenance.json.

Redistribution requires the applicable Microsoft Software License Terms
and a validly licensed copy of the relevant Visual Studio software.
The REDIST list permits unmodified files from the listed CRT directory
to accompany your application, subject to those terms. Availability on
a build machine is not by itself proof of the distributor's entitlement.

https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/cpp/windows/redistributing-visual-cpp-files
